youtube.title: Bubble Wrap Was Meant To Be Wallpaper 🫧 #Shorts
youtube.description:
Bubble wrap was supposed to go on your walls.

In 1957 two engineers sealed two shower curtains together to make textured wallpaper. It flopped, so did greenhouse insulation, until IBM used it to ship its fragile new computers. Bubble wrap took over the world.

Watch our full episodes on the channel.
